checks.title: User and job
checks.requirement: Identify the intended user’s need and the job the recommendation serves.

checks.title: Language evidence
checks.requirement: Separate observed forms and contextual readings from hypotheses; preserve provenance.

checks.title: Terminology
checks.requirement: Use the user’s/FLEx terms, explaining necessary MSA or engine abbreviations.

checks.title: Identity and scope
checks.requirement: Bind statements to the supplied project and exact objects; never invent identities.

checks.title: Affix meaning
checks.requirement: State the grammatical contrast and distribution before choosing inflection or derivation.

checks.title: MSA and category
checks.requirement: Check the relevant MSA, category and sense link instead of treating an affix string as a rule.

checks.title: Slots and templates
checks.requirement: Check template participation, declared slot order and required versus optional marking.

checks.title: Classes and features
checks.requirement: Distinguish arbitrary lexical conditioning from semantic/agreement features and sound environments.

checks.title: Parser reach
checks.requirement: Ground engine claims in the pinned importer and parser evidence; saving alone proves nothing about arrival.

checks.title: Positive readings
checks.requirement: Preserve every distinct approved morphology within the declared scope; one reading does not cover all.

checks.title: Negative evidence
checks.requirement: Use Reviewed negatives or a declared universe; unattested forms alone do not prove over-generation.

checks.title: Completion
checks.requirement: Keep unfinished, skipped or unassessed searches distinct from demonstrated absence.

checks.title: Proportionate change
checks.requirement: State parsimony and restrictiveness separately; check regressions and accept alternative valid solutions.

checks.title: Uncertainty and escalation
checks.requirement: Name what is unknown and ask a discriminating question; a person settles linguistic disputes.

checks.title: Authority and review
checks.requirement: Respect project ownership, human Apply and evidence binding to content and Baseline.

checks.title: Usable explanation
checks.requirement: Lead with the action/question, one concrete example, evidence and limits in plain language.
